2017 Q4.bq: So first, the number of patients taking Jakafi continues to grow very nicely, and Jakafi net sales for the full year were close to the upper end of our guidance range.

2019 Q2.gq: Moving to our guidance for 2019, we are increasing the low end of our Jakafi revenue guidance from $1.58 billion to $1.61 billion based on our results in the first half of the year.

2019 Q3.gq: In terms of Q4, we reiterated the guidance that we provided on both R&D and SG&A because there is a timing factor for some of the expenses on both lines that we expect to be more back-end loaded into Q4 of 2019 and, therefore, we continue to be comfortable with the initial guidance that we have provided.

2020 Q1.gq: Moving on to our guidance for 2020, we are reiterating our revenue, COGS, R&D and SG&A expense guidance for the year.

2020 Q2.gq: Moving on to our guidance for 2020, we are reiterating our revenue and expense guidance for the year.

2020 Q3.gq: We are reiterating our guidance for both R&D and SG&A.

2021 Q1.gq: Therefore, we are very confident in our full-year outlook for Jakafi and are reaffirming our guidance of $2.125 billion to $2.2 billion.

2021 Q2.gq: Based on the strong performance of Pemazyre in the first half of 2021, we are increasing the guidance range for other hematology oncology to a $155 million to $170 million.

2021 Q3.gq: Moving on to our guidance for 2021, we are reiterating our revenue COGS, R&D, and SG&A guidance for the year.

2023 Q1.gq: Given the strong underlying patient demand, we are confident in our full year outlook and are raising the low end of our guidance to a new range of $2.55 billion to $2.63 billion for the full year.

2025 Q3.gq: Sales for Monjuvi in follicular lymphoma, and Zynyz in SCAC, both launched this year, saw strong growth and contributed to our raised guidance.

2025 Q4.bq: For the full year '25, net sales were $4.35 billion, also up 20% year over year, exceeding both expectations and our guidance.

2026 Q3.gq: For hematology and oncology, we are raising full-year guidance to $890 million-$910 million, reflecting the performance across key growth brands.
